content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint lacks pre-specified statistical hypothesis or analysis method",
      "quote": "The primary endpoint is confirmed ORR assessed by ICR per RECIST v1.1 across all tumor types.",
      "page": 94,
      "section": "9.4.2.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The primary endpoint is described but no formal statistical hypothesis, null hypothesis, or analysis method (e.g., exact test vs. confidence interval only) is stated. The protocol does not specify how the primary analysis will be tested or what constitutes a statistically significant result.",
      "fix": "Add a formal statistical hypothesis for the primary endpoint, including null and alternative hypotheses, and specify the analysis method (e.g., one-sample exact binomial test) and how the confidence interval will be used for inference."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size not provided in the protocol",
      "quote": "A comprehensive SAP will be finalized prior to FSI and will describe the patient populations to be included in the analyses, and procedures for accounting for missing, unused, and spurious data.",
      "page": 92,
      "section": "9.4",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not include a sample size section or any justification for the number of patients. The extracted facts show sample_size is null. Without a sample size, the study's power and feasibility cannot be assessed.",
      "fix": "Add a sample size section that specifies the number of patients, assumptions (e.g., expected ORR, alpha, power), and the rationale for the chosen sample size."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing estimand attributes for primary endpoint",
      "quote": "ORR is defined as the proportion of patients who have a confirmed CR or PR, as assessed by ICR per RECIST v1.1.",
      "page": 94,
      "section": "9.4.2.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The estimand for the primary endpoint is incomplete: it does not specify the population (e.g., FAS or all patients with HER2 mutations), the handling of intercurrent events (e.g., death, treatment discontinuation, subsequent therapy), and the summary measure is only implicitly a proportion. The protocol mentions that patients who receive subsequent therapy and respond are not counted, but other intercurrent events are not addressed.",
      "fix": "Define the estimand for the primary endpoint with all attributes: population (e.g., FAS), variable (confirmed ORR), intercurrent event strategy (e.g., treatment policy, composite), and summary measure (proportion with 95% CI)."
    },
    {
      "title": "No analysis specified for PK endpoint",
      "quote": "Serum concentration of T-DXd, total anti-HER2 antibody and MAAA-1181a.",
      "page": 37,
      "section": "Table 8",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The PK endpoint is listed in the objectives and endpoints table, but the statistical analysis section (Table 17) does not include any analysis for PK data. The protocol only mentions that PK data will be analyzed in the PK Analysis Set, but no descriptive or inferential methods are described.",
      "fix": "Add a subsection under statistical analyses describing the PK analysis, including summary statistics (e.g., geometric mean, CV) and any planned PK parameters (e.g., AUC, Cmax)."
    },
    {
      "title": "No analysis specified for immunogenicity endpoint",
      "quote": "Presence of ADAs for T-DXd.",
      "page": 37,
      "section": "Table 8",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The immunogenicity endpoint (ADA) is listed in the objectives and endpoints table, but the statistical analysis section does not include any analysis for ADA data. The protocol only states that ADA data will be analyzed in the Safety Analysis Set, but no methods are provided.",
      "fix": "Add a description of the ADA analysis, including the number and percentage of patients with treatment-emergent ADA, and any statistical tests for association with safety or efficacy."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing handling of missing data for primary endpoint",
      "quote": "Data obtained up until disease progression, or the last evaluable assessment in the absence of progression, will be included in the assessment of ORR.",
      "page": 94,
      "section": "9.4.2.2",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not specify how missing data (e.g., missing response assessments) will be handled in the primary analysis. The quote only describes what data are included, but not how missing assessments are imputed or whether patients with missing data are considered non-responders.",
      "fix": "State the missing data handling strategy for the primary endpoint, e.g., patients with missing response assessments will be considered non-responders, or use a sensitivity analysis with multiple imputation."
    },
    {
      "title": "No multiplicity adjustment for secondary endpoints",
      "quote": "Secondary efficacy endpoints include confirmed ORR by Investigator assessment per RECIST v1.1, DoR (ICR and Investigator assessment), DCR, PFS, and OS.",
      "page": 94,
      "section": "9.4.2.3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not describe any multiplicity adjustment for the multiple secondary endpoints. Since several secondary endpoints are tested, the risk of type I error inflation is not addressed.",
      "fix": "Specify the multiplicity strategy, e.g., hierarchical testing, Bonferroni correction, or declare secondary endpoints as descriptive only."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent definition of analysis population for primary endpoint",
      "quote": "The FAS will be used for all efficacy analyses.",
      "page": 91,
      "section": "9.3",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The FAS is defined as all patients who received at least 1 dose, but the primary endpoint is ORR, which requires measurable disease at baseline. The protocol states that all patients will have measurable disease per inclusion criteria, but the FAS may include patients without measurable disease if they are enrolled erroneously. The MDAS is only for interim futility, so the primary analysis population is not clearly aligned with the endpoint definition.",
      "fix": "Clarify that the primary analysis for ORR will be based on the FAS, but note that patients without measurable disease at baseline will be considered non-responders, or use the MDAS for the primary analysis."
    }
  ]
}
